# Adopted from Daniel Schulz 

This script can be used to calculate signal to noise ratios for single cells from a images.

As an input an expression matrix will work (e.g. steinbock output).

Additionally, we will load images and masks and investigate the positive and negative clusters further. 


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
set.seed(22) #set global seed
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(imcRtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dittoSeq)
library(S4Vectors)
library(scater)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library(rlang)
library(data.table)
library(cytomapper)
library(BiocParallel)
```

Here we define a function that takes as an input:
- object: an sce object
- markers: character vector of markers found in the sce object
- group.by: a character string that defines the variable in the colData of the sce object to split groups by (e.g. image)

```{r}
SN_ratios <- function(object,markers, group.by){
  cur_dat <- data.table(t(assay(object[markers,],"exprs")))
  cur_dat[, as_name(group.by) := object[[group.by]]]
  cur_dat <- melt.data.table(cur_dat,measure.vars = markers, variable.factor = FALSE)
  cur_dat[, cluster := kmeans(value,centers = 2,nstart=100)$cluster, by = c(group.by,"variable")]
  cur_dat[, expr := mean(value), by = c(group.by,"variable", "cluster")]
  cur_dat <- as_tibble(dcast(cur_dat,formula = paste0(group.by,"+variable~cluster"),value.var = "expr", fun.aggregate = mean))
  colnames(cur_dat) <- c(group.by,"marker","cluster_1","cluster_2")
  cur_dat <- cur_dat %>%
    mutate(pos_cluster = ifelse(cluster_1 > cluster_2,cluster_1,cluster_2)) %>%
    mutate(neg_cluster = ifelse(cluster_1 > cluster_2,cluster_2,cluster_1)) %>%
    mutate(SN = pos_cluster/neg_cluster) %>%
    select(!c(cluster_1,cluster_2)) %>%
    arrange(marker)
  
    return(cur_dat)
}
```


# Application for RCC - Tumor panel titration 

## Titration dataset exploration 

```{r}
# Load SCE
sce <- read_steinbock("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/others/tumor_titration/", regionprops_folder = NULL, graphs_folder = NULL, return_as = "sce")
sce

#Load images and masks
images <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/others/tumor_titration/img/",BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 14,progressbar = TRUE,stop.on.error = FALSE))

masks <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/others/tumor_titration/masks/",BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 14,progressbar = TRUE,stop.on.error = FALSE), as.is = TRUE)

# Set channel-names for multi-channel images
panel <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/others/tumor_titration/panel.csv")
panel <- panel %>% filter(!is.na(clean_target))
channelNames(images) <- panel$clean_target

# Set mcols 
image_info <- data.frame(raw_names = names(images))

image_info$clean_names <- c(paste0(str_split(image_info$raw_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1],"_", str_split(image_info$raw_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,4])[1:28],
paste0(str_split(image_info$raw_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2],"_", str_split(image_info$raw_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1], "_", str_split(image_info$raw_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,5])[29:36])

mcols(images) <- mcols(masks) <- image_info
names(images) <- names(masks) <- image_info$clean_names
```

### cytoviewer

```{r}
library(cytoviewer)
cytoviewer(image = images, mask = masks, img_id = "clean_names")
```


## Prepare sce

```{r}
# panel and image information
images <-  read_csv("/Volumes/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_titration/images.csv")

# add dilution identifier
images$sample_id <- str_split(images$image, ".tiff", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

sce$clean_names <- image_info$clean_names[match(sce$sample_id, image_info$raw_names)]


sce$dilution_id <- sce$clean_names 
sce$dilution <- str_split(sce$dilution_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
sce$tissue_type <- str_split(sce$dilution_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]

# check that panel and rowData from sce match
identical(rownames(sce),panel$name)

# add arcsinh transformed counts
assay(sce,"exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce)/1)

# add clean target names to sce object
rowData(sce)$clean_target <- rownames(sce) <- panel$clean_target

# update colnames of sce
colnames(sce) <- paste0(sce$sample_id, "_", sce$ObjectNumber)
```

```{r}
#define markers for titration testing (markers that are apparent on most dilutions)
#rowData(sce)$use_channel <- 
rowData(sce)$use_markers <- rowData(sce)$clean_target %in% c("GPX4", "NFKB", "CycD1", "HIF1a", "p53", "cMYC", "ICAM1", "CD140b", "CD4", "PDK4", "CD73", "BRG1", "PKM2", "CD10", "IDH2", "HIF2a", "AuroraKinaseA", "EGFR", "S6", "VEGFR", "VHL", "Rb", "mTOR", "Fumarase", "GLUD12")
use_markers <- rowData(sce)$clean_target[rowData(sce)$use_markers]
```

## 1. ccRCC only 

```{r}
sce_RCC <- sce[,sce$tissue_type == "ccRCC"]

sce_RCC$dilution_cat <- ifelse(sce_RCC$dilution_id %in% c("100_ccRCC_3", "100_ccRCC_4", "50_ccRCC_3", "50_ccRCC_3"), "50_100", "25_12")
```

### UMAP 

```{r}
# define the markers of interest
cluster_markers <- use_markers

# calculate and plot UMAP
sce_RCC <- runUMAP(sce_RCC,exprs_values = "exprs", subset_row = cluster_markers)

plotReducedDim(sce_RCC,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "dilution_id")
plotReducedDim(sce_RCC,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "tissue_type")
plotReducedDim(sce_RCC,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "dilution_cat")
```

### Calculate signal to noise and check splits

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
# Main analysis
sn_dat <- SN_ratios(sce_RCC,use_markers,group.by = "dilution_id")
``` 

Here we check if the kmeans clustering actually does a meaningful separation of cells into two clusters, which we can do visually on the UMAP.

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
marker <- "VHL"
cur_dat <- as.matrix(t(assay(sce_RCC,"exprs"))[,marker])
cur_df <- as_tibble(colData(sce_RCC))
cur_df$expr<- cur_dat[,1]
clust_vec <- kmeans(cur_dat,centers = 2,nstart=100)
sce_RCC$clust_test <- as.factor(clust_vec$cluster)
p1 <- plotReducedDim(sce_RCC,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "clust_test")
p2 <- plotUMAP(sce_RCC, colour_by = marker, by_exprs_values = "exprs", 
                          point_size = 0.25, point_alpha = 1)
plot_grid(p1,p2)
```

### Plot signal to noise per marker

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
colors <- c("positive_cluster" = "black", "negative cluster" = "gray","signal to noise" = "red")
g <- ggplot(sn_dat)+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=pos_cluster, color="positive cluster"))+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=neg_cluster,col="negative cluster"))+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=SN,col="signal to noise"))+
  facet_wrap(.~marker, scales = "free")+
  labs(x="samples",
       y="Intensity [arcsinh] and signal to noise",
       color="Legend")+
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(angle = 90))
g

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/others/tumor_titration/data_analysis/out_tit_ccRCC_SNratios.pdf",width = 9,height = 10)
g
dev.off()
```

### Investigate pos and neg clusters on images

```{r load images and masks}
library(cytomapper)
images <- cytomapper::loadImages("/Volumes/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_titration/img/")
masks <- cytomapper::loadImages("/Volumes/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_titration/masks/", as.is = TRUE)
channelNames(images) <- rownames(sce)

# sample_id in the sce and names of the images match
names(images) <- unique(sce$dilution_id)
names(masks) <- unique(sce$dilution_id)

mcols(images)$dilution_id <- names(images)
mcols(masks)$dilution_id <- names(masks)

# scale the masks
#masks <- scaleImages(masks, 2^16-1)
```

### Check results on images

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
for(x in rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$clean_target == "CD8a"]){
  cur_sce <- sce[x,]
  
  for (i in unique(cur_sce$dilution_id)) {
  cur_sce_1 <- cur_sce[,colData(cur_sce)$dilution_id == i]
      cur_dat <- as.matrix(t(assay(cur_sce_1,"exprs")))
      cur_df <- as_tibble(colData(cur_sce_1))
      cur_df$expr<- cur_dat[,1]
      
      clust_vec <- kmeans(cur_dat,centers = 2,nstart = 100)
      cur_df$cluster <- clust_vec$cluster
      
     high_clust <- as.vector(cur_df %>%
       select(cluster,expr) %>%
       group_by(cluster) %>%
       mutate(mean_exp = mean(expr)) %>%
       select(cluster, mean_exp) %>%
       distinct() %>%
       ungroup() %>%
       top_n(n = 1,wt = mean_exp) %>%
       pull(cluster))
     
    cur_sce_1$cluster <-  cur_df %>%
       mutate(pos_clust = ifelse(cluster == high_clust,paste0("high_",i),paste0("low_",i))) %>%
       pull(pos_clust)

    cur_masks <- masks[names(masks) == i]
    cur_images <- images[names(images) == i]
    cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
    cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))
    #plot images and save
    plotPixels(image = cur_images,
               mask = cur_masks,
               img_id = "dilution_id",
               object = cur_sce_1[,cur_sce_1$cluster == paste0("high_",i)],
               cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
               colour_by = c(x), 
               outline_by = "cluster",
               save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/Volumes/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_titration/data_analysis/", x,"_",i,".png"), scale = 2)
               )
  
}
}
```
